newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Garuda Indonesia pilot held for Ecstasy possession.
newsitem.headline: Garuda Indonesia pilot held for Ecstasy possession.

text.p: Indonesia's national carrier Garuda has confirmed that one of its pilots has been arrested by Dutch police who have accused him of trying to smuggle the designer drug Ecstasy, the Antara news agency said on Tuesday.
"If he is guilty he faces criminal prosecution," Supandi, the airline's president director, was quoted as saying.

The Garuda pilot, referred to only as MS, was arrested at Amsterdam's Schipol airport on Sunday in possession of 8,000 Ecstasy pills. He was about to board a Garuda flight bound for Indonesia's holiday island of Bali.
Since April, the Indonesian government has arrested a number of people involved in trafficking the drug, which has gained popularity in recent years.
Indonesia is preparing a law to ban trade in, and use of, Ecstasy.
